exposure: Fear of birth trauma to the newborn
Fear of complications of vaginal delivery
outcome: Preference for vaginal delivery or cesarean section
finding: The majority of Pakistani women prefer vaginal delivery due to its natural process and faster recovery, while a smaller proportion favor cesarean section due to fear of birth trauma, labor pain, or complications.
mod_finding: The rising trend of cesarean sections in Pakistan cannot be attributed to the demand of expecting mothers, as the majority prefer vaginal delivery.
